newsitem.title: USA: CROSS-CONTINENT AUTO SAYS ENDS CHAISSON DEAL.
newsitem.headline: CROSS-CONTINENT AUTO SAYS ENDS CHAISSON DEAL.

text.p: Cross-Continent Auto Retailers Inc said Monday it agreed to end its previously announced agreement to acquire Chaisson Motor Cars.
The agreement provided for the purchase to occur on or before August 4, and Cross-Continent said it was unable to reach an agreement with Chaisson to extend the asset purchase agreement.
Aggregate consideration for the acquisition, as announced on April 17 and later amended, was about $25.0 million.
Cross-Continent said it expects to pursue other acquisitions in the Las Vegas market and enter new markets via acquisitions.
